title: The term over the parked chart

members.role: the held chart parks to its corner on the word that turns to the mechanism - it stays on stage, smaller, and is never cut away
the TERM lands as a card over the parked chart naming under: blur - the chart is not the point while the term is read (s124 (2)); hover when the chart must stay read
a flow explains the term, one node per clause, inside the card's beat

does: The chart parks, a term card lands over it on the blurred page and a short flow explains the mechanism; on the card's leave the blur clears and the chart returns.

use_when.act: NAMES / EXPLAINS - a term or mechanism the chart's move depends on
use_when.shape: a held chart + one named term and the two or three clauses that explain it
use_when.use: the chart blurs or parks, a term chip lands, a flow explains it, then the chart returns - the harvest's R3 (BUB 1:59; DOM 08:56-09:29; HIS 06:04; JPN 04:08, 05:28)
use_when.dont: longer than one proof beat; a term the chart itself already labels; blur when the chart must keep being read (hover, s124 amended)

source: P71 T15 (harvest v2 R3, n=4; BRAVOS-USE-WHEN R3). Its `under` member is pinned by the goldens dock-blur-over-plate and dock-hover-over-ledger; the whole beat is proved as a private TEST-BED beat on H row 12 ('inflated expectations', 134.07-136.10), labelled as one; no approved cut carries it
